year: Calendar year (1983-2026). NIFC standardized reporting begins 1983.
acres_burned_millions: Total U.S. acres burned per year in millions. Source: https://www.nifc.gov/fire-information/statistics
western_acres_burned_millions: Sum of NICC western GACC acres (NW NR GB RM SW NO SO; EB+WB pre-2015). Scripts/build_western_acres.py. 2010-2025.
acres_burned_partial: true when acres_burned_millions is YTD only
fs_treatment_millions: Forest Service hazardous fuels treatment (millions). NPR/USFS FACTS 2023-2025 only.
interior_treatment_millions: Interior Dept hazardous fuels treatment (millions, fiscal year). https://www.doi.gov/wildlandfire/fuels
dsci_avg: Contiguous U.S. annual avg DSCI. USDM API aoi=conus. Available from 2000.
dsci_partial: true when dsci_avg is partial year
dsci_west_avg: NWS Western Region annual avg DSCI. USDM API NWSRegionStatistics aoi=WR.
dsci_west_partial: true when dsci_west_avg is partial year
ten_year_avg_millions: Ten-year average acres burned 2013-2022 (millions). CRS IF10244
